title: Does a bullish impulse bar become support on first revisit?
limitations: Commission is modelled but slippage and spread are not
A bar touching both barriers is counted as a loss
This tests one fixed impulse and revisit definition, not every support-zone formulation
reopeningConditions: A preregistered definition with positive net expectancy on a new untouched period
A causal context filter that survives its own chronological validation
The result remains positive after spread and slippage
